ToD_A01_M04_OBJE_003.en: The time we have been waiting for has finally come! All who oppose the Horde must be taught a harsh lesson. Burn Hillsbrad to the ground - leave no one alive!

ToD_A01_M04_OBJE_004.en:
|cffffcc00MAIN QUEST|r
The Fall of Hillsbrad
  - Destroy Hillsbrad

ToD_A01_M04_OBJE_005.en:
|cffffcc00MAIN QUEST COMPLETED|r
The Fall of Hillsbrad

ToD_A01_M04_OBJE_008.en: The Gilneans were foolish enough to test our Armada on the open waters, now they flee like the cowards they are. Show them the true price of their arrogance, and send them all to the bottom of the sea!

ToD_A01_M04_OBJE_009.en:
|cffffcc00OPTIONAL QUEST|r
Lambs to the Slaugther
  - Sink the retreating Gilnean warships

ToD_A01_M04_OBJE_010.en:
|cffffcc00OPTIONAL QUEST COMPLETED|r
Lambs to the Slaugther

ToD_A01_M04_OBJE_013.en: Veterans from the fall of Stormwind have entrenched themselves on a nearby island, pestering you with their constant attacks. Their knowledge of our ways of war makes them dangerous, kill them all!

ToD_A01_M04_OBJE_014.en:
|cffffcc00OPTIONAL QUEST|r
Remnants of Stormwind
  - Destroy the forces of Stormwind

ToD_A01_M04_SCRN_001.en: Build more Farms to continue unit production.,Build more Pigfarms to continue unit production.,Summon more Ziggurats to continue unit production.,Create more Moon Wells to continue unit production.

ToD_A01_M04_SCRN_002.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
Watch tower. Your peons can now build watch towers that increase visibility of the area and can be upgraded to a guard tower.

ToD_A01_M04_SCRN_003.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
Blacksmith. Build a blacksmith to improve the weapons and armor of your warriors.

ToD_A01_M04_SCRN_004.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
Grunts can learn new skills at the Barracks with the upgrade "Horde Melee Training".

ToD_A01_M04_SCRN_005.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
Foundry. By building the Foundry you will get the opportunity to build transport ships and improve the armor and weapons of your warships.

ToD_A01_M04_SCRN_006.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
Refineries.
Oil refining is an important part of naval expansion. Building refineries enables you to extract even more oil. It is recommended that you build refineries in close proximity to oil rigs, as this enables your tankers to deliver the resource as a faster rate.

ToD_A01_M04_SCRN_007.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
You can now build transport ships. This will help you transfer troops to the other side of the channel.

ToD_A01_M04_SCRN_008.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
You can improve the armor and weaponry of ships at the Foundry.

ToD_A01_M04_SCRN_009.en:

ToD_A01_M04_SCRN_010.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
Guard tower. By building a watch tower, you can upgrade it to a guard tower, thereby increasing the effectiveness of the defense of the camp.
